name: Lone square pier 901
prompt: a freestanding fragment of a stone aqueduct, one arch on weathered piers with a broken water channel on top, lone square pier, tall, about two people high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

adopted: recovered from the PixelLab store 2026-08-13: runs 5/6 were cancelled mid-pass and their committed-but-unpushed art died with the runners; the store object survived. Index 900+ band avoids colliding with the concurrently-running pass.
recovered_spec: metadata restored by replaying run 5's deterministic planner at its checkout (a21c4bc8); orphan creation order matched the planned sequence exactly

LIT_2.glow_concept: soulstone veins glowing through cracked masonry

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the cyan cracks across the stone brighten a little and return. It is lit and clearly visible in every frame, including the first. It gets only SLIGHTLY brighter -- never white, never washed out -- and keeps its own colour throughout: brightest in the middle, back to its first-frame brightness at the end. It stays exactly the same size and shape in every frame: it never grows and never spreads, only its brightness shifts. Every object stays the same kind of thing it is in the first frame and keeps its own colour: nothing turns into anything else. Nothing is added or removed anywhere: every object appears in every frame, the same number of them, in the same places, at the same size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour, no outline redrawn. The last frame matches the first exactly.
